state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap`, `Core\Ldap\Filter`, `Core\Ldap\Dn`, `Core\Ldap\Sid`, `Core\Ldap\Ad` and `Core\Ldap\Change` owe nothing.

**13 of the 17 `Core\Ldap\Entry` members owe nothing:** `dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`, `toArray`, `int`, `bool`, `uuid`, `sid`, `sids`, `instant` and `duration`. Every member has its tests proof. `isDeleted`, `accountFlags`, `groupType` and `accountType` still owe `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench: `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Ldap\Entry'` lists them.

**The three proof trees are granted `[ldap.corp]` by directory** in the root `nvs.toml`. Run a draft from the repository root with `target/covws/<triple>/debug/nvs.exe run docs/examples/core/Ldap-Entry/<member>/<file>.nvs`; run from inside the tree, the grant is not found. `docs/examples/core/Ldap-Entry/int/` is a model for an example, an attack and a bench.

**The `samba-ad` domain is seeded** by `20-novis-seed` in `tests/db/compose.yaml` (its comment lists every user, group and password). `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `CN=Reader,OU=Company,DC=example,DC=test`.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** RIDs follow the seed order (`Reader` 1103, `Employees` 1104, `Managers` 1105, `Newsletter` 1106, `anna.berg` 1107, `ben.kohl` 1108, `dora.lind` 1110), `Administrator` is 500 and the only account with `isCriticalSystemObject`. `userAccountControl` is 512 for `anna.berg` and `carla.diaz`, 514 for `dora.lind` and 66048 for `ben.kohl` and `Reader`. `carla.diaz` has `pwdLastSet` 0. Anna's `tokenGroups` RIDs are 513, 545, 1104 and 1105. The domain has `maxPwdAge` 6w, `minPwdAge` 1d, `lockoutDuration` 30m, `minPwdLength` 7 and `pwdHistoryLength` 24. GUIDs, SIDs and timestamps differ per boot.

**`Reader` cannot read any attribute of a deleted object.** A `showDeleted: true` search finds `CN=Deleted Objects`, but its entry has no attributes, so `isDeleted()` is `false` there, and the seed deletes nothing.

next.note: Each member owes `about.md`, three examples with `.out` from `--bless`, one attack and one bench, then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Ldap\Entry'`, which runs past 10 minutes, so start it in the background.

items.text: **The AD readers `accountFlags`, `groupType` and `accountType` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`), at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:210`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:226` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:236`. The seeded facts above cover all three: `dora.lind` is disabled, `carla.diaz` must change the password, `Newsletter` is a distribution group.

**`isDeleted` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`), at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:708`. A live example needs a tombstone `Reader` can read: add to the seed at `tests/db/compose.yaml:416` a user that is created and deleted, and a `samba-tool dsacl set` that gives `Reader` list and read rights on `CN=Deleted Objects`, then recreate the container. If Samba does not honour that grant, the examples show `false` for live entries and a skip entry carries the reason for the rest.

backlog: A single-value reader given a list says "`strings` returns all of them" even for `sid`, where `sids` is the reader to name: `only_value` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:206`, pinned by `tests/conformance/core/ldap-single-value-readers-throw-for-a-list.nvst`.

`Core\Ldap\Connection` (`setPassword`, `changePassword`, `compare`), `Core\Ldap\Entries` (`references`, `total`) and `Core\Ldap\Changes` (`cookie`) still owe proofs; `total` and `cookie` also lack a Rust `covers:` test.
Stage 4: a CA a program supplies. Stage 6: wiring the schema into the readers.
